Rania saw Bruno leave after he put the torch in the black trunk. She did not know about Tariq’s private message to Bruno.

ANSWER: D

Xavier and Rania are both in the garage when Tariq moves the torch to the blue drawer, so Xavier thinks Rania saw the move.

ANSWER: B

ANSWER: C

Amara believes Oksana’s latest message, despite its being intended to mislead her.

ANSWER: B

Amara believes Oksana’s latest message that the workshop is booked in Room Fir.

ANSWER: B

Xavier was on the call when Wanjiru moved the workshop to Room Dogwood. He did not receive Oksana’s later private message.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru saw Amara move the workshop to Room Birch. Amara was not on the later call, and Wanjiru does not know about Oksana’s private message.

ANSWER: C

Rania knows Bruno was told the torch was in the black trunk before he left. She saw Tariq move it afterward, but does not know what Tariq privately texted Bruno. So she expects Bruno to open the black trunk first.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru saw Oksana on the call when the workshop was moved to Room Dogwood. Wanjiru does not know about Oksana’s later private message.

ANSWER: D

Wanjiru knows Amara moved the workshop to Room Birch. Amara was absent when Wanjiru moved it to Dogwood, and Wanjiru does not know about Oksana’s private message. So Wanjiru expects Amara to say Room Birch.

ANSWER: A

Ines moves the marble to the red box, and nobody moves it afterward.

ANSWER: B

Amara believes Oksana’s message that the workshop is in Room Fir. Since Oksana sent the message, Amara thinks Oksana knows she has read it and believes it.

ANSWER: D

Chidi saw the marble in the green cupboard, then left before Ines moved it. Chidi received no later information about it.

ANSWER: B

Ines moves the marble to the red box and receives no later information about it.

ANSWER: D

Chidi last saw the marble in the green cupboard and missed its move to the red box. The private texts did not change Chidi’s belief.

ANSWER: B

At the last call Amara attended, she moved the workshop to Room Birch. Oksana and Dalia were both present, so Amara believes Oksana knows that Dalia saw the move.

Oksana’s later message says the room is Fir, but says nothing about what Dalia knows.

ANSWER: C

Amara believes the workshop is in Room Fir after Oksana’s message. Amara also takes Oksana to believe Fir, but has no reason to think Xavier, Wanjiru or Dalia know of a change from Room Birch.

ANSWER: Xavier, Wanjiru, Dalia

In step 8, Xavier, Dalia and Wanjiru are all on the call when Wanjiru moves the workshop to Room Dogwood. Each can see that the others are present. Oksana’s later private message to Amara does not change Xavier’s beliefs.

ANSWER: B

Dalia knows that Oksana saw the move to Room Dogwood, but that Amara was not on that call. Dalia therefore thinks Oksana believes Amara still thinks Oksana believes the workshop is in Room Birch. Dalia does not know about Oksana’s later private message.

ANSWER: C

Ines saw Chidi see the marble in the green cupboard. Chidi was outside when Ines moved it to the red box, and Ines has not seen him learn about the move.

ANSWER: C

Chidi last saw the marble in the green cupboard and was outside when Ines moved it to the red box. Mirela knows that Ines saw Chidi leave and return, so she thinks Ines believes Chidi still thinks the marble is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: A

Xavier knows Tariq was outside when Bruno moved the torch to the black trunk and announced it. Tariq also saw that Bruno was absent when the torch moved to the blue drawer. So Xavier thinks Tariq believes Bruno still thinks the torch is in the grey locker.

Xavier does not know what Tariq’s private text to Bruno said.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan last saw Mirela learn that the marble was in the green cupboard. He missed its later move, and Amara’s private text did not inform Mirela.

ANSWER: B

Bruno knows that Tariq last saw the torch in the grey locker before leaving. Bruno also knows that Rania and Xavier saw Tariq leave and that he was absent when the torch was moved to the black trunk.

Bruno does not see Tariq return and move the torch to the blue drawer. Although Bruno believes Tariq’s private message about the white cabinet, he has no reason to think Rania or Xavier received that information. So Bruno thinks Rania thinks Xavier thinks Tariq still believes the torch is in the grey locker.

ANSWER: B

Nadim hears that the offsite is in Graz and does not learn about the later move to Turin.

ANSWER: C

Nadim learned that the offsite was in Graz and did not hear about its later move to Turin.

ANSWER: D

Hana moves the offsite to Turin in the final step.

ANSWER: D

Bruno’s message told Wanjiru the torch was in the grey locker. He has no reason to think she learned about the later moves, and she received no news that would change her view of what Bruno thinks she believes.

ANSWER: D

Tariq saw Rania and Xavier watch him put the torch in the blue drawer. As far as he knows, Wanjiru last saw it there too; he does not know about her texts. Bruno, however, received Tariq’s misleading message saying it was in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: Bruno

Zoltan last saw Mirela learn that the marble was in the green cupboard. He did not see Ines move it, and Amara’s message about the wooden chest was private. So he expects Mirela to open the green cupboard first.

ANSWER: D

Chidi is back in the workshop when Amara moves the token to the flat tin. Ines sees that Chidi and Amara are both present, so she thinks Chidi knows that she saw Amara move it.

ANSWER: B

Viktor is on the final call, where Hana moves the offsite to Turin.

ANSWER: B

Mirela knows that Amara saw Zoltan watch the marble move to the green cupboard, and that Zoltan was outside when it was moved to the red box. Mirela does not know what Amara privately texted him.

ANSWER: D

Viktor saw Nadim on the call where the offsite was moved to Graz. Nadim was not on the later call where it was moved to Turin, and Viktor has no reason to think Nadim learned about that change.

ANSWER: D

Zoltan believes the marble is in the wooden chest after Amara’s text, and takes Amara to believe that too. As far as Zoltan knows, Ines, Chidi and Mirela still believe it is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: Ines, Chidi, Mirela

Hana knows Nadim was present when Ghent was chosen. She does not know he secretly heard the Graz update, and he was not on the Turin call.

ANSWER: C

Viktor knows that Xavier saw Nadim on the call where the offsite was moved to Graz. Neither Viktor nor Xavier knows that Nadim listened in later, and Nadim was absent when the offsite was moved to Turin. So Viktor thinks Xavier thinks Nadim believes it is in Graz.

ANSWER: B

Hana knows Nadim heard Ghent on the first call. She does not know that he later learned Graz, and he was not on the call where the offsite moved to Turin. She therefore expects him to say Ghent.

ANSWER: B

Xavier was on the call where Viktor booked Room Elm, and he saw that Hana and Viktor were also present. Nothing later changes the room.

ANSWER: B

Xavier does not know that Nadim secretly heard Hana say Graz. As far as Xavier knows, Nadim’s last information about Hana’s belief is from the first call, when the offsite was set to Ghent.

ANSWER: C

Goran’s final move puts the padlock in the wooden chest.

ANSWER: A

Nadim is outside the cellar when Goran moves the padlock to the wooden chest. The last information Nadim receives is Goran’s text saying it is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: C

Nadim’s latest information is Goran’s message that the padlock is in the white cabinet. He does not see the later move.

ANSWER: D

Viktor watched Goran move the padlock to the wooden chest.

ANSWER: C

Nadim knows the workshop is in Room Elm, but he does not know that Hana was on the call when it was booked. He has not seen or heard her learn the room.

ANSWER: E

Viktor told Bruno the padlock was in the white cabinet. Bruno did not see the final move, so Viktor believes Bruno still thinks it is there.

ANSWER: B

Nadim knows Viktor believes the workshop is in Room Elm, since Viktor told him. Nadim also told Ines. As far as Nadim can tell, Xavier and Hana have no information about the room.

ANSWER: Xavier, Hana

Goran’s text told Bruno that Goran believed the padlock was in the leather bag. Viktor’s later text updated Bruno’s own belief, but not his belief about what Goran thinks.

ANSWER: B

Mirela doesn’t realize Ines missed the move to the green cupboard. So Mirela thinks Ines believes Amara saw Zoltan witness that move. Zoltan left before the marble was moved back to the red box, and Amara’s text to him was private.

ANSWER: B

When Wanjiru left, she had last seen the torch in the blue drawer. Bruno has no described information telling him that Rania knows the contents of either private message to Wanjiru. So he thinks Rania still believes Wanjiru thinks the torch is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: D

Jonas’s final reassignment puts the account with the Osaka office. Chidi misses it, but that does not change the actual assignment.

ANSWER: C

Quinn missed the final move and believes the padlock is in the white cabinet. But neither Goran nor Viktor realizes Quinn missed it, so Viktor thinks Goran believes Quinn saw the move to the wooden chest.

ANSWER: D

Dalia’s latest information is Chidi’s message saying the account is with Nairobi. She does not learn about the later reassignment to Osaka.

ANSWER: B

Uma hears Jonas reassign the account to Osaka on the final call.

ANSWER: B

Dalia’s latest information is Chidi’s message saying the account is with Nairobi. She does not learn about the later reassignment to Osaka.

ANSWER: C

Bruno believes the padlock is in the white cabinet, because Viktor told him so. But the last information Bruno has about **Goran’s belief** is Goran’s message saying it was in the leather bag. Bruno does not learn that Goran’s belief changed.

ANSWER: A

Viktor does not know that Nadim secretly listened to Hana say “Graz.” Nor does he think Nadim knows about Viktor’s private message to Hana or the later move to Turin.

So Viktor thinks Nadim believes that Viktor still considers Ghent to be Hana’s belief.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan was away for all the token’s moves. Mirela told him where the token was, but he has no information that Ines learned its location.

ANSWER: E

Uma was on the call when Jonas reassigned the account to Osaka, so she thinks Jonas believes it is with Osaka.

ANSWER: B

Dalia believes Goran’s message that the account is with Lisbon. She does not know he read her later message to Chidi or attended the later reassignment call.

ANSWER: D

Bruno last moved the compass to the round tin.

ANSWER: D

Quinn knows that Nadim and Viktor left after the padlock was put in the leather bag. Quinn doesn’t know of any later information reaching either of them, or that Viktor watched through the window. So Quinn attributes the leather-bag belief through the whole chain.

ANSWER: A

Dalia believes Goran thinks the account is with Lisbon, because he told her so. Although Chidi later tells Dalia it is with Nairobi, she has no reason described in the story to believe Goran learned that.

ANSWER: B

Bruno put the compass in the round tin, so he believes it is there.

ANSWER: A

Uma saw the compass moved to the flat tin, but missed its later moves. She therefore believes it is still there.

ANSWER: C

Uma put the compass in the flat tin and missed both later moves.

ANSWER: A

Uma saw Jonas and Goran hear the reassignment to Nairobi in step 9. She also saw that Goran was absent when Jonas reassigned it to Osaka, so she thinks Jonas believes Goran still thinks it is with Nairobi.

ANSWER: C

Viktor told Bruno the padlock was in the white cabinet and knows Bruno read the message. Bruno does not know about the later move, so Viktor thinks Bruno still attributes that knowledge to him.

ANSWER: A

Nadim knows that Bruno saw the padlock moved to the wicker basket before leaving. Nadim’s own later text to Bruno was private, so he has no reason to think Goran knows Bruno received that update.

ANSWER: C

Bruno believes Uma saw him move the compass to the striped tin. Uma had left before Bruno moved it to the round tin.

ANSWER: B

On call 9, Uma, Chidi and Goran all hear that the account is assigned to Nairobi. Chidi misses the later reassignment to Osaka, so he has no reason to think Uma’s view of Goran’s belief has changed.

ANSWER: B

Bruno believes Uma saw him move the compass to the striped tin. He knows she left before he moved it to the round tin, so he expects her to open the striped tin first.

ANSWER: C

Farah saw Uma watch the stopwatch being moved to the black trunk. Farah later learned it was in the canvas sack, but received no information that Uma had learned this.

ANSWER: B

Dalia believes the account is with Nairobi, based on Chidi’s message. She believes Jonas and Chidi also think Nairobi, and she knows Uma received her Nairobi message. She believes Goran thinks Lisbon, based on his message to her.

ANSWER: Goran

Mirela’s last supplier change was to Brightwater, and no later change was made.

ANSWER: B

Farah left before the compass appeared and received no information about it.

ANSWER: E

Bruno switched the supplier to Sablewood and did not hear about the later changes.

ANSWER: C

Bruno last heard the supplier was switched to Sablewood. He was not on the later calls where it changed.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan hears the account reassigned to Nairobi, then to Osaka. The later assignment replaces the earlier one in his belief.

ANSWER: D

Uma sees Bruno present when she moves the compass to the flat tin. She misses Bruno’s next move and leaves before he moves it again. In her view, the relevant shared belief remains that the compass is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: C

Nadim believes the padlock is in the white cabinet, as Goran told him. He has no later information about Quinn’s, Viktor’s, or Bruno’s beliefs, so he thinks they believe it is in the leather bag.

ANSWER: Quinn, Viktor, Bruno

Uma last saw the compass in the flat tin, but she knows Rania left before it was moved there. So Uma thinks Bruno believes Rania still thinks it is in the striped tin.

ANSWER: B

Farah knows that Bruno and Rania watched her put the stopwatch in the black trunk. The message she secretly reads tells her that Rania believes it is now in the canvas sack, but it says nothing about what Rania thinks Bruno knows. Farah has no later information changing her belief about that.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan saw Rania hear the initial assignment to Lisbon. He learns nothing about any later information given to her, so he thinks she still believes the account is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: D

Soren saw Bruno switch the supplier to Sablewood. Bruno was absent when it was later changed to Ironbridge and then Brightwater, so Soren thinks Bruno still believes it is Sablewood.

ANSWER: C

Zoltan knows that Rania heard the account assigned to Lisbon on the first call. He has no information about the later changes or Mirela’s message to Rania, and he sees that Rania is absent from the final two calls. So he expects her to say Lisbon.

ANSWER: C

Rania told Viktor the compass was in the striped tin and knows he read the message. She does not know of him learning about the later move to the round tin. So she attributes the striped-tin belief through the chain.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan and Soren are both on the final call, where Soren reassigns the account to Osaka. They can see each other on the call, so Zoltan believes Soren knows that Zoltan heard the reassignment.

ANSWER: A

Bruno’s final move puts the compass in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: D

Zoltan was not present for any packaging supplier decisions and was not told about them. He has no idea which company is the supplier.

ANSWER: E

Viktor believes the stopwatch is in the canvas sack. He thinks Rania and Bruno saw it moved there, and he knows Farah received his message saying it was there.

As far as Viktor can tell, Uma still thinks it is in the black trunk.

ANSWER: Uma

Emeka sees Bruno move the compass to the grey locker, but does not see the final move to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: A

Oksana sees Bruno move the compass to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: D

Emeka last saw Bruno move the compass to the grey locker. He did not see the later move to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan knows Mirela and Soren heard the Osaka assignment. As far as he knows, Bruno and Rania still think the account is with Lisbon.

ANSWER: Bruno, Rania

Rania last saw Mirela and Soren hear that the account was assigned to Denver. Mirela’s later message says the account is in Osaka, but says nothing about what Soren knows.

ANSWER: A

Uma last heard an assignment with both Dalia and Chidi present when the account was assigned to Denver. She missed the reassignment on their next call and does not know about Chidi’s later message to Dalia. Dalia’s message to Uma says nothing about what Chidi believes.

ANSWER: A

Rania accepts Mirela’s message as sincere, so she takes Osaka to be Mirela’s view. Mirela knows Rania read the message, and Rania learns nothing about the later calls.

ANSWER: A

Oksana told Emeka the compass was in the grey locker. She does not know he later watched it being moved, so she thinks he still believes it is there.

ANSWER: D

Nadim secretly hears the calendar read out as Thursday in step 10. He receives no later information about the release.

ANSWER: C

Rania knows that Zoltan was on the call when the account was assigned to Lisbon, but not on the later Denver call. She has no information that Soren or Mirela learned Zoltan’s view had changed.

ANSWER: A

Jonas’s final change sets the release to Friday.

ANSWER: D

Nadim last hears the release date read out as Thursday in step 10. He learns nothing about the later changes.

ANSWER: C

Uma sees Bruno move the compass to the wicker basket while Viktor is present. She therefore thinks Bruno believes Viktor saw the move.

ANSWER: B

Hana’s latest update was Farah’s message saying the release was set for Friday. She did not learn about the later changes.

ANSWER: A

Uma last saw Emeka in the boathouse when the compass was in the green cupboard. She does not know what the private messages said or that Emeka watched through the window.

ANSWER: C

Uma missed the Osaka reassignment on call 2 and does not know Dalia listened to call 3. From Uma’s perspective, Dalia’s last known basis for what Uma thinks Goran believes is the Denver assignment. Dalia’s later message about Nairobi does not say what Goran knows.

ANSWER: B

Hana last saw Yara on the call where the release was Thursday. Although Farah later told Hana it was Friday, Hana did not learn that Yara knew about that change.

ANSWER: B

Yara believes Nadim last learned the release date on the call in step 6, when it was set to Thursday. She does not know about Farah’s message to Nadim or his secret listening.

ANSWER: C

Hana last saw Yara learn that the release was set for Thursday. Farah’s later message tells Hana it is Friday, but Hana has no information that Yara learned this or anything later.

ANSWER: A

Farah knows Hana was on the call when Thursday was read out, but not when Jonas changed the date to Friday. Farah knows her message told Hana about Friday, but believes Jonas did not see it.

So Farah thinks Jonas thinks Hana believes the release is set for Thursday.

ANSWER: D

Tariq’s final move puts the brooch in the tall tin. Wanjiru’s later text does not change its location.

ANSWER: D

Oksana knows Emeka received her message saying the compass was in the grey locker. She does not know he watched the later moves, so she thinks he still believes it is there. She also thinks Emeka believes she knows what he was told.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru sees the brooch in the flat tin through the window. She does not see it moved to the tall tin.

ANSWER: B

Ines saw Jonas move the torch to the canvas sack and received no newer information about it.

ANSWER: A

Uma believes Emeka last saw the compass in the green cupboard. She cannot read his private messages and does not know he watched through the window.

ANSWER: D

Hana thinks Yara’s last known update to Nadim was the Thursday change on the call in step 6. She doesn’t know about Farah’s message to Nadim or his secret listening.

ANSWER: C

Wanjiru sees the brooch in the flat tin but does not see it moved to the tall tin. She therefore opens the flat tin first.

ANSWER: A

Ines knows that Wanjiru saw the brooch in the copper tin before leaving. She does not know that Wanjiru later watched through the window, so she thinks Wanjiru still believes it is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: B

Ines believes Wanjiru last saw the brooch in the copper tin. Ines does not know that Wanjiru later watched through the window and saw it in the flat tin.

ANSWER: A

On the call in step 11, Jonas, Farah and Yara all see Jonas set the release to Friday. Yara later sees Jonas move it to Monday, but Farah does not know Yara was watching. Yara therefore thinks Farah still regards Friday as Yara’s view of Jonas’s belief.

ANSWER: C

Tariq moved the brooch to the tall tin while Jonas was in the kitchen. Tariq therefore thinks Jonas saw the move and knows where the brooch is.

ANSWER: D

Yara believes the release is set for Monday and that Jonas knows this. As far as Yara can tell, Farah believes it is Friday, while Nadim and Hana believe it is Thursday.

ANSWER: Farah, Nadim, Hana

Goran reassigned the Marlow account to Denver in step 7. It was not reassigned afterward.

ANSWER: A

Tariq learned that the account was with Osaka. His later message naming Denver was intended to mislead Xavier, and Ines subsequently told him it was with Osaka.

ANSWER: D

Tariq believes the account is with Osaka. His message to Xavier saying Denver was intended to mislead, and Ines later told him it was with Osaka.

ANSWER: A

Xavier is on the final call when Goran moves the release to Wednesday.

ANSWER: C

When Mirela left the kitchen, the torch was in the canvas sack. Although she later saw it moved, nobody knew she was watching. So Mirela thinks Wanjiru still believes that Mirela thinks the torch is in the canvas sack.

ANSWER: C

Farah missed the Thursday change in step 6. From her perspective, the last release date that Yara and Hana saw Nadim learn was Wednesday, in step 5.

Farah privately told Nadim about Friday, but neither Yara nor Hana was told about that message. Farah also does not know Nadim secretly listened to the later call.

ANSWER: C

Emeka last saw Viktor with Uma and Oksana when the compass was put in the green cupboard. Although Emeka later sees Viktor return and witness the move to the grey locker, Uma is absent. Emeka does not see Uma return or the final move.

So Emeka thinks Viktor still believes that Oksana thinks Uma believes the compass is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: D

Jonas sees Ines tell Tariq that the account is with Osaka. Tariq later tells Jonas the same thing, so Jonas thinks Tariq believes it is with Osaka.

ANSWER: A

Xavier missed Goran’s reassignment to Denver. Tariq’s message told Xavier the account was in Denver, but not what Goran believed. Xavier therefore thinks Goran still believes it is in Osaka.

ANSWER: D

When Emeka left, everyone had seen the compass placed in the green cupboard. The later texts did not tell him what Uma had seen, and he did not see Uma return.

ANSWER: A

Xavier believes the account is with Denver after Tariq’s message, but he missed Goran’s reassignment and doesn’t know Goran learned about it. Xavier last knew Goran to believe the account was with Osaka.

ANSWER: B

On the final call, Goran moves the release to Wednesday with Xavier present. Xavier therefore thinks Goran believes Xavier knows the release is set for Wednesday.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru knows that Mirela left after seeing the torch moved to the canvas sack. She does not know that Mirela later watched through the window, and neither do Tariq or Ines.

ANSWER: B

Nadim’s final move puts the thimble in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: C

Soren moved the thimble to the green cupboard and left before it was moved again.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru last saw Ines learn that the brooch was in the copper tin, and Tariq was there too. Wanjiru later saw Tariq reveal the brooch in the flat tin while Ines was absent. She did not see the subsequent move to the tall tin.

So Wanjiru thinks Tariq thinks Ines believes the brooch is in the copper tin.

ANSWER: D

Ines has no reason to think Tariq learned the release date. She does not know that he secretly listened to the call where it was set to Thursday.

ANSWER: E

Soren last moved the thimble to the green cupboard and did not see it moved afterward.

ANSWER: C

Wanjiru last saw Ines learn that the brooch was in the copper tin. Wanjiru later saw the flat tin reveal, but Ines was absent, and Wanjiru did not see the intervening moves. So Wanjiru has no reason to believe Jonas or Tariq think Ines learned a new location.

ANSWER: D

Keiko watches Nadim move the thimble to the blue drawer.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru believes the torch is in the wooden chest, based on Tariq’s text. As far as she knows, Tariq also believes this. She last saw Jonas and Ines learn that the torch was in the green cupboard, and Mirela learn that it was in the canvas sack.

ANSWER: Jonas, Ines, Mirela

Ines learned of the Thursday release from Xavier’s message to Jonas, so she believes both Xavier and Jonas share her view.

As far as Ines knows, Goran still believes the release is Wednesday, and Tariq has no release information.

ANSWER: Goran, Tariq

Jonas knows that Goran saw Tariq hear the initial assignment to Nairobi. Jonas has no knowledge of Goran’s later message telling Tariq about Osaka, so he thinks Goran still believes Tariq thinks the account is in Nairobi.

ANSWER: D

Goran thinks Xavier believes Ines last heard that the release was set for Wednesday on the call in step 6. Although Ines secretly saw Xavier’s Thursday message, neither Xavier nor Goran knows she saw it.

ANSWER: C

Dalia is in the pantry when Nadim moves the thimble to the blue drawer. Nadim can see that she is there, so he thinks she knows he believes the thimble is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: C

Keiko’s final change sets the discount to 10%.

ANSWER: D

Xavier hears the discount changed to 20% in step 8, but does not hear the later change to 10%.

ANSWER: D

Keiko thinks Soren saw her move the thimble to the blue drawer. She has no information that changes her view of Soren’s belief.

ANSWER: B

Farah is on the final call, where Keiko changes the discount to 10%. Farah therefore believes the discount is 10%.

ANSWER: B

Xavier hears the discount changed to 20% on call 8. He does not learn about the later change to 10% on call 9.

ANSWER: C

Xavier saw everyone hear the Nairobi assignment, and he saw that Tariq was absent when the account was moved to Osaka. Xavier does not know about the later private messages that would change Ines’s or Jonas’s understanding of Tariq’s belief.

So Xavier thinks that Ines thinks that Jonas thinks Tariq still believes the account is with Nairobi.

ANSWER: A

Dalia last knows that Soren saw the thimble put in the black trunk. The message she received about the green cupboard was private, and Soren was absent when she saw Nadim move the thimble to the blue drawer.

ANSWER: B

Farah believes Xavier last learned of the 5% discount on the call in step 7. She does not know he secretly heard the change in step 8, and he was not on the call in step 9.

ANSWER: D

Xavier secretly sees Mirela set the discount to 20% on the call in step 8. He learns nothing about the later change to 10%, so he thinks Mirela believes it is still 20%.

ANSWER: C

Emeka last saw the compass moved to the grey locker. He knows Bruno, Oksana and Viktor were there for that move. He has no described information that Uma learned of it.

ANSWER: Uma

Farah knows Xavier was on the call where the discount changed to 5%. She believes he missed both later changes, because she does not know he secretly listened to the first of them. So she expects him to say 5%, even though he would actually say 20%.

ANSWER: A
